description: Month-level header showing the actual-vs-projected split as three columns: Spent so far, Still due, Income. Plus a dual net line (net so far / projected net). This is the headline of the calendar and the primary expression of the double-count fix.

spentSoFar.description: Sum of actual expenses this month (cents or dollars; real money already gone, incl. paid bills)

stillDue.description: Sum of UNPAID projected bills remaining this month. MUST stay separate from spentSoFar.

onToday.description: Shown only when not viewing current month

projectedNet.label: Projected net
projectedNet.note: muted to read as a forecast

accessibility.label: {monthLabel}. Spent so far {spentSoFar}. Still due {stillDue} from {unpaidBillCount} unpaid bills. Income {income}.
accessibility.note: Split is conveyed via labels + marker shape, not color alone.

developerNotes: spentSoFar and stillDue must be passed as separate props and never summed before display — this is the guard against the double-count regression.
